title: Engine Intelligence & Decision Validation
architecture_decision_label: Multi-engine coherent — no arbitration layer required
central_question: Do the deterministic engines make coherent, useful, internally consistent decisions for realistic, extreme, sparse, and contradictory user states?
answer: Yes, after 4 confirmed correctness defects were reproduced and fixed with minimal, regression-tested changes. No speculative architecture, no AI added to deterministic features, no schema changes.

defects.name: Recovery workload contradiction
defects.reproduce: detectRecoveryMode active:true suggestedDailyTasks:3, but buildDailyPlan listed 5 tasks
defects.root_cause: buildDailyPlan ignored recovery.suggestedDailyTasks and mapped the full task array

defects.name: Forecast active-day denominator
defects.reproduce: 300 XP over 3 active days in 7 days -> daysEstimated 3, basis '100 XP/day over last 3 active day(s)'
defects.root_cause: recent XP divided by count of active days instead of calendar days
defects.fix: denominator fixed at 7 calendar days; daysEstimated = ceil(xpNeeded*7/recentXp); basis 'last 7 days'

defects.name: Chat intent over-matching
defects.root_cause: substring includes() matched short tokens inside longer words
defects.fix: whole-word boundary matching for single-token patterns; plural variants added

defects.name: Weakness false positives on sparse data
defects.reproduce: totalXp 15, STRENGTH 7 -> 6 weaknesses each score 55 / confidence 0.67
defects.root_cause: low-attribute gap gated only on maxAttr > 0, flagging untrained (0) attributes

verification.api_smoke: PASS (11 life-engine endpoints + legacy paths, all 200)
verification.offline_smoke: PASS (no GROQ_API_KEY; deterministic surfaces work; open-ended chat 503 graceful)

determinism: byte-identical JSON across repeated calls for every engine

architecture.dependency_graph: flat composition via orchestrator; single intra-engine edge quest-engine -> recommendation-engine
architecture.duplicated_signals: weakestAttribute and goal keys read-only in two places, consistent, no loop

ai_changes: NONE (no AI added to deterministic features)

final_report.CONTRADICTION CLASSES: D x4 (correctness), C x0 (no arbitration needed)
final_report.RECOMMENDED NEXT STEP: Proceed to release; engines are internally consistent and regression-protected
